title: Getting Drunk on the Holy Ghost
description: Join Pastor Chris Zehner as he unleashes a powerful and energetic sermon that will leave you feeling the presence of God and hungry for more. Tonight, Pastor Chris dives into the theme of being "drunk in the Holy Ghost" and shares a liberating message that will challenge your perspective on what it means to be filled with the Spirit. With a message that's equal parts prophetic and practical, this sermon is sure to ignite a fresh fire of passion and freedom within you.
